annotation.title_clean: Det Europæiske Kontor for Kunstig Intelligens | Shaping Europe's digital future
annotation.title_en: The European Office for Artificial Intelligence | Shaping Europe's digital future
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission (DG CNECT), European AI Office
annotation.summary_en: Danish-language European Commission page describing the European AI Office: its structure (including an Excellence in AI and Robotics unit), its role implementing and enforcing the AI Act, especially for general-purpose AI, innovation initiatives, international cooperation and advisory bodies. Robotics appears only as a unit name.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Office enforces AI Act rules for general-purpose AI models, with powers to evaluate, request information and fine.
Has over 125 staff in six units, including 'Excellence in AI and Robotics' (A1).
Supports the AI Board, scientific panel, advisory forum, AI Pact and Apply AI Alliance.
Promotes sandboxes, AI factories, the AI Continent Action Plan and the Apply AI Strategy.
AI Omnibus amendments to the AI Act adopted in 2026 to simplify rules.
